answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, while equivocation evidence links coordinated keys into a single fault set. If k identities corroborate conflicting histories, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), so adding sybils increases exposure faster than voting power. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making a walnut grove of aliases economically untenable while exposing the kernel of shared control.
